checks.name: Signer is accessible before a project is open and opens native private workflow
Desktop HTML states actual Android signer is required
Open project exports explicit private-signing handoff without identity claims
Public receipt is attached as new evidence without altering source or owner runtime observations
Same versionCode replacement is accepted while downgrade and mismatched identity claims are rejected
Cancelled or invalid native receipt makes no evidence or success claim
Public edition keeps both destinations available and explains first-time runtime setup

scope: Source-level DOM/native callback/export contract. No native signing, rendering, phone install, or external AI execution is established by these checks.
